sylfilter_bin.description: Path to the sylfilter executable binary.

db_path.description: Directory path where sylfilter stores its .db files.

kv_engine.description: The key-value store engine to use. Options: QDBM, SQLite.

method.description: Filtering method. 'n' for Paul Graham (Naive Bayes), 'r' for Gary Robinson (Robinson-Fisher).

min_dev.description: Minimum deviation threshold. Ignore if score near this value.

rob_s.description: Robinson's s parameter. Only used when method is 'r'.

rob_x.description: Robinson's x parameter. Only used when method is 'r'.

no_bias.description: Do not bias probability for clean mail. Only effective if method is 'n'.
